usedFor: FastSpring sells software online, and “Create a Quote” builds a sales quote while “Create an Account” adds a customer account.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a Quote” in FastSpring
bestTemplate.why: It builds a sales quote for a customer with items, so an offer starts from one step.

watchOut: A quote that reaches a customer outside your team waits in Needs you for your approval before it goes.
